test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On 15 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Seizing the opportunity, Akhil decided to __take the bull with the horns__.

options.text: take the bull on the horns
take the bull by the horns
take the bull at the horns
take the bull in the horns

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

**__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"take the bull by the horns"** means to confront a problem head-on and deal with it directly and confidently. (समस्या का डटकर सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **When the project faced unexpected delays, the manager decided to take the bull by the horns and worked overtime to get it back on track.
 
 
 
• The expression **"take the bull with the horns"** is incorrect and does not convey the intended meaning. (गलत अभिव्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example: **Seizing the opportunity, Akhil decided to take the bull with the horns. (Incorrect)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.
